# clickup_folder_templates (Data Source)





<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Required

- `team_id` (Number) Workspace ID

### Read-Only

- `templates` (Attributes List) Array of Folder templates available in the Workspace. (see [below for nested schema](#nestedatt--templates))

<a id="nestedatt--templates"></a>
### Nested Schema for `templates`

Read-Only:

- `id` (String) Unique identifier of the Folder template. IDs are prefixed with `t-` (e.g., `t-7162342`). Use this ID as the `template_id` path parameter in the Create Folder From Template endpoint.
- `name` (String) Name of the Folder template
